summary: Master advanced management skills with our specialized training course for personal, executive, and administrative assistants.
lede: Training for administrative assistants develops practical systems for managing priorities, delegating work, and coordinating executive support. It is designed for experienced personal, executive, and administrative assistants handling confidential information, changing priorities, and cross-functional commitments. Participants practice prioritizing and delegating with the Eisenhower Matrix and RACI, preparing decision-ready briefings, and coordinating tasks with Microsoft 365 tools.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate executive priorities, administrative workflows, confidential information, and cross-functional commitments. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who already perform core support duties and now need stronger management systems, influence, and operational judgment.
modules: Assistant Performance Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: You should have at least one year of experience in personal assistance, executive assistance, office administration, board support, project administration, or a related coordination role. You need practical familiarity with calendars, email, meetings, task tracking, and confidential workplace information. No coding or programming is required. Advanced digital concepts, including Power Automate and dashboard design, are taught at an operational application level rather than a technical engineering level. Bring examples of recurring workflows or anonymized support challenges if your organization permits.
